response: {"headline": "SOLID-TIMI 52 failed to show darapladib reduces major coronary events after ACS; the companion STABILITY trial gave HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.85–1.03), consistent with a non-causal Lp-PLA2 target.", "summary": "The SOLID-TIMI 52 trial randomized 13,026 patients after acute coronary syndrome to darapladib or placebo, powered at 90% to detect a 15.5% relative risk reduction with 1,500 planned primary endpoint events over a planned 3-year median follow-up. The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke. The companion STABILITY trial in stable coronary heart disease (15,828 patients, 3.7-year median follow-up) showed HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.85–1.03) with 1,588 total events (769 treatment, 819 control).
